name: Fieldmouse Post
subtitle: Copper pipes, golden meadow
shortDescription: Rotate copper pipes inside a cut-away meadow so every mouse's letter reaches its own door: 100 boards, a Daily Post and Night Shift.
longDescription:
Somewhere under the wheat, a stack of letters waits in the dark, and every mouse in the burrow knows which door it belongs to.

Fieldmouse Post is a slow, tactile pipe puzzle set in a cut-away block of meadow under a low golden sun. Tap a tile to turn it a quarter, join each mouse to the door that carries its mark, then watch the whole post run home along the route you laid. Turning is free and only counts when you decide to chase a star.

### Ten Worlds, One Hundred Boards
Each world adds a single new mechanism: bolted pipes and plank bridges, one-way brass plates, switch junctions, season gates, belts and turntables, wax seals, washouts and rising floodwater, express letters. The tenth board of every world, a Sorting Office, uses everything at once. Every board is proven solvable, and three stars equal the true shortest number of turns.

### Around The Burrow
- Daily Post: one new board each morning, the same for everyone, with a streak, a weekly streak-freeze and a postmark calendar.
- Night Shift: chain boards while the lantern oil burns down, then beat your own record.
- The Stamp Map and Album: 120 stamps to collect, twelve costumes for your mice and eight mailboxes.
- The Post Office shop: coins earned by delivering mail buy lasting upgrades such as a hint satchel. Coins are never sold for money.

No lives and no timers in the campaign. Works offline without an account, with Reduce Motion, large type and VoiceOver names for every tile.
whatsNew: Version 1.0 launch: 100 boards across ten worlds, a Daily Post with a streak, the Night Shift record chase and 120 stamps to collect.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
